7685932867339209998.brief: The original promotes another app's oral quiz (Turbo AI). Our version uses Memo AI's oral quiz page https://www.memoai.eu/ugc/oral-quiz: the creator opens it on a laptop, picks their language and presses play. It is a dialogue between the app's voice tutor (TUTOR - these lines play as audio from the page, the creator does NOT say them) and the creator (CREATOR - the creator says these short answers out loud themselves, live, in the pauses). Exactly like the original: the creator films their own face reacting (embarrassed / laughing) while the quiz runs and answers, then turns the camera to the laptop screen with the quiz. The script is this dialogue with the page's own wording for the page language (Slovenian page: the Slovenian version; Serbo-Croatian page: the Croatian version - creators can also pick Bosnian or Serbian on the page), for the same lines the original plays (if the original stops mid-way, stop at the same point). Mark every TUTOR line with a direction like '(Memo AI govori)' / '(govori Memo AI)' so creators know it plays from the page, and put cue 'memo' where the laptop with the oral quiz is shown. The dialogue names no app, so no line names Memo AI. 'DICK' is the medical mnemonic (dextrose, insulin, calcium, Kayexalate) and the joke of the format - keep it. SLOVENIAN: TUTOR 'Tvoja pacientka potrebuje malo DICK-a. Kako ji ga daš?' / CREATOR 'Seveda samo s privolitvijo.' / TUTOR 'Pacientka je nezavestna. Privolitve ne more dati.' / CREATOR 'Oh.' / TUTOR 'Potem ji moraš DICK vseeno dati.' / CREATOR 'Brez privolitve?' / TUTOR 'Zapomni si: DICK pomeni dekstroza, insulin, kalcij in Kayexalate.' / CREATOR 'Oh.' / TUTOR 'Dati jih moraš v tem vrstnem redu, in sicer takole. Dekstroza gre najprej kot IV bolus, da insulin ne zniža preveč krvnega sladkorja. Insulin gre IV takoj za njo in v približno petnajstih minutah potisne kalij v celice. Kalcijev glukonat daš IV v nekaj minutah, da zaščitiš srce pred aritmijo, medtem ko kalij pada. Kayexalate pride zadnji, skozi usta ali rektalno, da odvečni kalij za vedno odstrani iz telesa.' CROATIAN: TUTOR 'Tvojoj pacijentici treba malo DICK-a. Kako ćeš joj ga dati?' / CREATOR 'Pa naravno, samo uz pristanak.' / TUTOR 'Pacijentica je bez svijesti. Ne može dati pristanak.' / CREATOR 'Oh.' / TUTOR 'Onda joj DICK moraš dati svejedno.' / CREATOR 'Bez pristanka?' / TUTOR 'Zapamti: DICK znači dekstroza, inzulin, kalcij i Kayexalate.' / CREATOR 'Oh.' / TUTOR 'Moraš ih dati tim redoslijedom, i to ovako. Dekstroza ide prva kao IV bolus, da inzulin ne sruši šećer u krvi. Inzulin ide IV odmah za njom i za otprilike petnaest minuta potiskuje kalij u stanice. Kalcijev glukonat daješ IV kroz nekoliko minuta da zaštitiš srce od aritmije dok kalij pada. Kayexalate ide zadnji, na usta ili rektalno, da zauvijek izbaci višak kalija iz tijela.'
